fields.title: tooling: migrate all pi sessions to jj-vcs (replace direct git usage)
fields.description:
Goal
----
User uses jj-vcs (jujutsu) for all version control. Pi sessions and tau extensions should default to jj commands instead of raw git. This avoids subtle conflicts (e.g., jj working-copy snapshots vs. git porcelain expectations) and matches user's actual workflow.

Scope
-----
1. Audit every git-* call in extensions/tau for jj-equivalents:
   - git_commit_with_user_approval tool: should detect jj repo and use 'jj describe' / 'jj new' / 'jj git push' instead of 'git commit'
   - extensions/tau/src/commit/index.ts: same
   - extensions/tau/src/services/persistence.ts: any git diff/status calls
   - extensions/tau/src/sandbox/*: git invocations in sandbox preset
2. Detection: presence of .jj/ in workspace root signals jj mode; otherwise fall back to git.
3. Pi host (~/.pi/...) should also prefer jj when available. May require host-side changes outside tau.
4. Document the workflow in extensions/tau/docs (or AGENTS.md): how tau handles jj vs git.

Constraints
-----------
- Do not require jj to be installed (graceful fallback to git).
- Keep external CLI surface stable (commands like /commit work the same).
- jj commands often need escalated sandbox (writes to .git/objects when colocated with git). Verify sandbox config plays nicely.

Acceptance
----------
- Tau detects jj repos and uses jj commands by default.
- git remains the fallback when no .jj/ present.
- New regression tests cover detection + dispatch.
- AGENTS.md documents the jj-first preference.
- No prompts in normal jj workflow (push, commit) when sandbox preset is full-access.

Refs
----
- User memory ffFGk0zA0FSL: 'jj-vcs (not raw git), SSH origin, feature branches, bun runtime'
- Concrete pain points hit during tau-1qfx work: had to manually invoke 'jj git push -b' instead of the project's existing commit/push tooling.
